repositoryVerification.note: POST /api/github/verify against the fake GitHub service (network = loopback), includes DB writes

launchAuthorize.note: includes signing-policy evaluation (live chain reads) + attestation signing with the LOCAL test signer; NOT KMS latency

fullLaunchSimulation.note: fresh user → bind → verify → draft → authorize → creator EIP-712 signature → launch tx mined on Anvil → submitted

treasuryDashboard.note: treasuryReport(): materialized ledger + live contract reads at the checkpoint

workerBacklogRecovery.note: one runWorkerOnce pass after 2000 empty blocks accumulated (batch size = FORGE_INDEXER_BATCH_BLOCKS)

caveat: Sandbox measurements only. They say nothing about production throughput (real GitHub latency, KMS signing latency, Postgres network round-trips, RPC latency).
